mapping_policy.scope: IMF WEO source identity crosswalk only; does not change the project identity registry, ISO/M49 assignments, or other provider mappings.
mapping_policy.unmatched_identities: Remain unresolved and excluded from candidate observations unless separately owner-approved.
mapping_policy.no_inference: No fuzzy, name-only, ISO-inferred, coordinate-based, or automatic identity matching.

review_approval.scope: Field 15 / NGDPD only; existing owner-approved WBG and KOS mappings plus explicitly approved new rows in the owner review.

mappings.review_note: Explicit project-owner-approved, field-15-only crosswalk. The IMF October 2026 WEO Appendix identifies WBG as West Bank and Gaza and classifies it as an individual economy entry. The existing project UN M49 snapshot matches the Palestine registry identity to State of Palestine (M49 275, PS/PSE) via a reviewed name variant. Target game_id is persistent and exact. This source-specific mapping does not verify or modify the registry ISO assignment status.

Explicit project-owner-approved IMF WEO October 2026 NGDPD field-15-only mapping. The WEO CSV source identity is KOS; the October 2026 IMF Appendix Country Data Documentation identifies Kosovo as UVK. The canonical registry contains this persistent game_id with English name Kosovo and source/geometry key KOS, but its registry status is proposed, entity_type is unreviewed, and ISO assignment status is unverified. The separate Game DB countries record for the same game_id has record_status approved, entity_type disputed_or_partially_recognized_entity, and entity_type_status reviewed. This provider-specific approval does not promote or otherwise change the canonical registry record. The KOS/UVK discrepancy is acknowledged as a source-code qualification, not resolved by an asserted IMF concordance. No global ISO/M49 assignment, identity-registry record, or other provider mapping is changed.
